title: OL-20261114-5: seed carries the owner's outreach intro profile (upstream leaks fails on main)
body:
**Owner:** outreach-manager
**Trigger:** upstream leaks fails on main (found 2026-11-14 while landing SELF-REFERENCE-1)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation upstream leaks
**Status:** open

seed/outreach/intro-profile.json is the instance's own profile (named owner, QNFO) copied into the kernel, so every new org would introduce itself as this owner and 'python3 -m foundation upstream leaks' fails on main since #339. Replace the seed copy with a template whose fields bootstrap fills from IDEA.md, keep outreach/intro-profile.json as the instance copy, and keep seed/scripts/test_outreach_intro.py green.
